description:
[Servers] Servers predicted to wipe in the next 48 hours. The "wiping in the next 48 hours" list from servers.rustprofit.com/wipes: the busiest servers whose own wipe
pattern (learned from their detected wipes: weekday + hour for weekly servers, every N days, fortnightly...)
puts their next wipe inside the window, soonest first. Each entry: `next_wipe_at` (UTC, an estimate),
`schedule` (e.g. "weekly, Fridays ~21:30 UTC"), `on_schedule` of `considered` past wipes that fit it, `reason`
and the server (`id`, `name`, `country`, `players`, `connect`, `vanilla`, `url`). The monthly force wipe is not
listed per server - every server wipes then; see `force_wipe` here and `/servers/force-wipe`. `total` counts every
server predicted in the 48-hour window, `results` only the busiest 100 of them. Rebuilt after every poll cycle. Busiest servers predicted to wipe soon (their own schedule). The monthly force wipe is separate: get_force_wipe.

country.description: Only servers hosted in this ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country.
